articles.title: Your health and Sweat
ways_to_achieve: Engaging in moderate-to-vigorous aerobic exercise like running, cycling, or brisk walking
Utilizing a sauna or steam room safely under timed heat exposure
Participating in high-intensity interval training (HIIT) or hot yoga
benefits: Regulates core body temperature to prevent heat exhaustion and overheating
Flushes out surface impurities and supports pore cleanliness

articles.title: Proper Hydration and Recovery
articles.description: Maintaining Fluid and Electrolyte Balance After Physical Exertion
ways_to_achieve: Drinking water consistently before, during, and after sweating
Replenishing essential sodium and potassium through electrolyte drinks or coconut water
benefits: Prevents muscle cramping, dizziness, and blood volume loss
Supports rapid cellular recovery and optimal nervous system function
